name: io.github.fnguerrero/eflens
title: EfLens
description: Read-only database MCP server for .NET: safe SQL, query plans, EF Core model and drift detection.

environmentVariables.name: EfLens__Provider
environmentVariables.description: Database engine: sqlite, sqlserver or postgres.

environmentVariables.name: EfLens__ConnectionString
environmentVariables.description: Connection string of the database to inspect. Use a read-only login.

environmentVariables.name: EfLens__EfAssembly
environmentVariables.description: Path to the compiled app (.dll) that contains the DbContext, for ef_model and ef_drift.
